detail.longDescription:
I am making a very simple video player. I want the video to display in full screen mode. I give the user two ways to choose a file to play. One works and one does not. The way that works listens to a div for a 'drop' event. The even triggers a routine that enters full screen and loads the video. In the way that does not work, the user clicks a button that opens the file picker. The javascript listens for the 'change' event and triggers a similar routine, but I get an error message that a user gesture is required for full screen. (The file still loads and plays, just not in full screen...) HTML
Drag and drop a video here or...
listeners: dropBox.addEventListener("drop", drop); fileSelector.addEventListener('change', readFile); The routines: function drop(e) { document.getElementById('vidContainer').requestFullscreen(); vidLoading = true; e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault(); var dt = e.dataTransfer; var files = dt.files; loadVideo(files); } function readFile(e) { document.getElementById('vidContainer').requestFullscreen(); var files = e.target.files; loadVideo(files); }
